about_the_game:
About Draftcraft

Draftcraft is an innovative blend of deck-building, semi-real-time 3D combat, and Roguelike adventure. Step into a dynamic world of trials where every challenge is unique. Refine and enhance any stat on each card to build a powerful, fully customizable deck. Face off against ferocious bosses, master strategic combat to survive the rampaging chaos.

Game Features

  • Dynamic Deck Building

    Discover a wide variety of cards as you journey through each trial. Freely select and customize their stats to forge devastating combinations and unleash massive damage.

  • Procedurally Generated Challenges

    No two runs are the same. Enemy stats and encounters change with every trial, offering fresh, unpredictable gameplay every time you enter the arena.

  • Deep Card Customization

    Refine and enhance your cards with the powerful bead system. Combine beads in unique ways to trigger magical effects and build game-changing strategies.

  • Semi-Real-Time 3D Combat

    Experience a thrilling mix of action and strategy. In this semi-real-time combat system, timing, positioning, and planning are key to overcoming deadly monsters in a fully 3D battlefield.

  • 100+ Cards

    Unlock and experiment with over 100 distinctive cards. Mix and match to create incredible combos, discover hidden synergies, and define your personal playstyle.
